get.description:
Liveness check.

Returns simple status to confirm the API is running.

Readiness check — verifies DuckDB connectivity.

Per ADR-001/D-32, DuckDB is an optional, non-load-bearing store: it is only
read on-demand by backtest/risk. The readiness probe therefore reports the
database as the sole dependency; it must NOT gate on the (retired)
indicator-cache tables, which would mark a healthy API as degraded once the
legacy indicator_values rows are dropped.

Returns:
    - 200 with {"status": "healthy", "checks": {...}} if the DB is reachable
    - 503 with {"status": "degraded", "checks": {...}} if it is not

get.description:
Get a plain-English explanation of a financial metric.

Falls back to static template explanations for 20 core metrics.
Accepts metric name variations (e.g., 'pe_ratio', 'P/E', 'pe').

Calculate position size using conviction-adjusted Kelly.

Uses the formula: position_size = min(kelly_base, position_cap, sector_cap)
where kelly_base = equity × risk_pct × conviction_mult / risk_per_share.

post.description:
Run a single backtest using a template and Yahoo Finance data (no vectorbt).

Uses the ExternalBacktestEngine which fetches data from Yahoo Finance,
computes indicators with pandas_ta, and runs simulation with pure pandas/numpy.

Pre-warm the yfinance OHLCV cache for the given (or default) symbols.

The function calls the same fetchers used by the orchestrator, so
subsequent `POST /api/v1/ticker/{symbol}/analyze` calls will hit the
cache (TTL 6h) instead of re-fetching from yfinance.

get.description: Returns all rows from the paper-trade journal DB (both open and closed).
After-close orders waiting for a T+1 fill. status=pending (default) or all for the filled/expired history.
Returns rows with no date_closed (the current open book), plus active pending orders — signals that have not filled yet.
Returns rows with a date_closed (the measurable sample for expectancy).
Returns the account value minus open notional, with sector exposure.
Returns the path to the paper-trades directory for debugging.
Canonical 29-col CSV (chronological) plus template/regime/entry_timing/max_hold_days — Excel remains an output format, never the store.
Most-recent-first rejections from the journal DB (gate/sizing failures).
Most-recent-first run records for enforce / sync-exits / run-close.

post.summary: Touchpoint A — Run gate enforcement and queue after-close orders
post.description: Fills eligible pending orders from actual bars, fetches the morning brief, evaluates candidates through the 7-step gate, and queues accepted signals as pending orders. Orders fill on the next session (T+1), never the signal day.

post.summary: Touchpoint B — Sync exits from OHLCV (infer + apply)
post.description: Fetches daily OHLCV for open journal rows, infers exit (stop/target/time), and when apply=true writes exit data + plan_adherence to the journal DB.

post.summary: One-go after-close run — Touchpoint A then B(apply)
post.description: Fills eligible pending orders from actual bars, queues today's accepted signals as pending (T+1), then applies exit inference to the open book — in one call, so forgetting one of the two touchpoints is impossible. Writes a single workflow_runs row (mode='run_close').

get.description: Returns rolling expectancy, win rate, profit factor for each template/regime combination. Elite badge requires n>=30 and expectancy>0.
Returns only combinations with n>=30 trades and positive expectancy.

post.summary: Get rolling expectancy for a symbol/template/regime
post.description: Computes rolling expectancy over the last N trades for a specific filter.

get.description: Simulated screen-template replay stored in replay_runs / replay_trades. Deliberately separate from the forward journal: replay rows never count toward expectancy or the kill rule. Returns {run, rows, summary}; run is null until `python run_paper_replay.py` has been run.

delete.description: Deletes replay_runs / replay_trades rows. The forward journal is untouched.

ChartReadingAnalysis.title: ChartReadingAnalysis
ChartReadingAnalysis.description:
All advanced chart reading signals across timeframes — separated from core TechnicalAnalysis.

This sub-model groups all institutional-grade chart reading signals:
- BOS/CHoCH (structure.py)
- Volume Profile TPO (volume_profile.py)
- Smart Money Concepts: OB, FVG, Breakers, Liquidity (smc.py)
- Validated Breakouts (breakout.py)
- Multi-timeframe Confluence (mtf_confluence.py)

Keeping these separate from TechnicalAnalysis prevents model bloat
and allows optional computation (only when OHLCV data is available).

TVScreenRequest.description:
Request for TV Screener discovery.

`config` can be a dict (inline ScreenConfig) or a string (template name).
`enrich_with_catalysts` (D-47 PR 1) runs the 5 D-46 catalyst signals
(sector RS, post-earnings drift, analyst revision, insider cluster,
options flow) on each result. Off by default because it adds 5-10s
per result; turn on for the morning-ritual screen.
